problem: Which set is equivalent to $A={x\in R:|2x+5|=13}?$
worked_solution:
The elements of the given set are the real numbers that satisfy the equation $|2x+5|=13.$ So, we first need to solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}|2x+5| & =13 \\ 2x+5 & =\pm 13 \\ 2x & =-5\pm 13 \\ x & =\frac{-5\pm 13}{2} \\ x & =-9,4\end{aligned}
$$

The solutions are $x=-9$ and $x=4,$ and both of these solutions are real numbers.

Therefore, we can write the given set as

$$
A={-9,4}.
$$
